'''Tomáš Cihlář''' (born 1967) is a [[Czechs|Czech]] biochemist known for his role in the development of [[remdesivir]]. A specialist in virology, Cihlář holds the positions of senior director, biology, and vice-president at American pharmaceutical company [[Gilead Sciences]]. As a student, Cihlář assisted fellow biochemist [[Antonín Holý]] in developing [[Tenofovir disoproxil|Viread]], the primary drug used to fight HIV infection.<ref>[[Czech News Agency]], [https://rmx.news/article/article/could-czech-scientists-have-the-cure-for-coronavirus "Did Czech scientists create the cure for coronavirus?"], [[Aktuálně.cz]], 5 February 2020.</ref>

==Early life and education==
Cihlář was born in 1967 in [[Plzeň]], [[Czechoslovakia]] (now the [[Czech Republic]]). He graduated from the [[University of Chemistry and Technology, Prague]], majoring in fermentation chemistry and bioengineering under the tutelage of Jan Páca and Vladimír Jirků. He completed his postgraduate studies at the [[Institute of Organic Chemistry and Biochemistry]] of the [[Czech Academy of Sciences|ASCR]] under Ivan Rosenberg and Ivan Votruba. In 1994 he obtained the title of Candidate of Sciences and was engaged in the research of antiviral agents under the tutelage of [[Antonín Holý]].

That same year, he traveled to the United States for a postdoctoral fellowship with Gilead Sciences, where as researcher he worked on the development of antiviral nucleotide analogs including [[Tenofovir disoproxil|tenofovir disoproxil fumarate]], which, marketed as Viread, has become a primary drug in the fight against HIV infection.<ref name="hstalks">Anon., [https://hstalks.com/expert/1983/dr-tomas-cihlar/ Dr. Tomas Cihlar], HSTalks.</ref>

==Career==
At Gilead, leading a team of hundreds of scientists working on new substances for the treatment of [[HIV/AIDS|HIV]], viral [[hepatitis B]], respiratory infections and other viral diseases such as [[Ebola]], [[MERS]], and [[dengue fever]], Cihlář is as of 2020 responsible for biological research on HIV and respiratory viruses. On a number of these projects, he continues to work closely with scientists from the Institute of Organic Chemistry and Biochemistry, particularly Zdeněk Havlas and Zdeněk Hostomský,<ref>Anon., [https://www.vscht.cz/oslavy/zaznam-konference#cihlar The future of (not only) chemistry - ICT Conference: Tomáš Cihlář, Advances and new directions in the treatment of HIV infection], University of Chemistry and Technology, Prague.</ref> and with the Radim Nencka Group,<ref>Římanová, R., [http://www.avcr.cz/cs/veda-a-vyzkum/chemicke-vedy/Remdesivir-Nadeje-na-zastaveni-koronaviru-dostala-v-Cesku-zelenou/ Remdesivir: Naděje na zastavení koronaviru dostala v Česku zelenou—Akademie věd České republiky], [[Czech Academy of Sciences]], 18 March 2020.</ref> which develops compounds capable of stopping the replication of important human pathogens by blocking the remodeling of cell membranes induced by these viruses.<ref name="PN">[https://nencka.group.uochb.cz/cs/publikace Publikace Nencka group], Institute of Organic Chemistry and Biochemistry of the CAS.</ref>

Cihlář is engaged in ongoing research into HIV inhibitors that target the enzyme [[integrase]] and prevent the formation of [[Capsid|viral capsids]].<ref>Anon., [https://www.gilead.com/news-and-press/press-room/press-releases/2020/3/new-clinical-study-data-for-gileads-investigational-hiv-1-capsid-inhibitor-gs-6207-presented-at-croi-2020 New Clinical Study Data for Gilead’s Investigational HIV-1 Capsid Inhibitor GS-6207 Presented at CROI 2020], Gilead Sciences, Inc., 11 March 2020</ref> Recently, these entail low molecular weight [[agonist]]s of [[TLR7]] (toll-like receptor 7).<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Bam|first1=Rujuta A.|last2=Hansen|first2=Derek|last3=Irrinki|first3=Alivelu|last4=Mulato|first4=Andrew|last5=Jones|first5=Gregg S.|last6=Hesselgesser|first6=Joseph|last7=Frey|first7=Christian R.|last8=Cihlar|first8=Tomas|last9=Yant|first9=Stephen R.|date=2017-01-01|title=TLR7 Agonist GS-9620 Is a Potent Inhibitor of Acute HIV-1 Infection in Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells|journal=Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy|language=en|volume=61|issue=1|doi=10.1128/AAC.01369-16|issn=0066-4804|pmid=27799218|pmc=5192112|doi-access=free}}</ref> TLR7 receptors recognize single-stranded RNA in [[endosome]]s and play a role in innate antiviral immunity. Such substances should help eliminate the HIV reservoir in T-lymphocytes and completely cure HIV patients.<ref name="PN" />

In 2006, Cihlář received a [[William Prusoff#Prizes|William Prusoff Young Investigator Lecture Award]] from the [[International Society for Antiviral Research]] for his work on [[Reverse-transcriptase inhibitor|antiviral nucleotide analogs]]. He has patented dozens of novel inventions.<ref>[https://patents.justia.com/inventor/tomas-cihlar Patents by Inventor Tomas Cihlar], [[Justia|Justia Patents]].</ref> In 2025 he was awarded the [[Warren Alpert Foundation Prize]].<ref>[https://www.warrenalpert.org/prize-recipients/ Warren Alpert Foundation Prize 2025]</ref>

===Remdesivir===
Also at Gilead, Cihlář is one of the company's lead researchers in the development of [[remdesivir]],<ref>Paulenková, K., [https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/leky-koronavirus-chemici-vyzkum-ceska-stopa.A200207_101018_domaci_aug Česká stopa v léku proti koronaviru. Naši chemici patří ke světové špičce], [[Mladá fronta DNES|iDNES.cz]], 8 February 2020.</ref><ref>Burrows, M. J., & Preble, C. A., [https://nationalinterest.org/feature/urgent-need-adjust-america%E2%80%99s-approach-world-162637 "The Urgent Need to Adjust America’s Approach to the World"], ''[[The National Interest]]'', 12 June 2020.</ref> originally intended for treatment of Ebola. However, the Ebola epidemic ended before the new drug could be tested. Remdesivir briefly showed considerable promise in treating [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19 infection]];<ref>Holshue, M. L., Debolt, C., Lindquist, S., Lofy, K. H., Wiesman, J., Bruce, H., & Spitters, C., [https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2001191 "First Case of 2019 Novel Coronavirus in the United States"], ''[[The New England Journal of Medicine]]'', 5 March 2020.</ref> in April 2020 the company provided 5,000 doses for experimental use in China<ref>Anon., [https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/veda/3050302-do-ciny-zasilame-testovaci-vzorky-lek-muze-dorazit-v-kvetnu-tvrdi-spoluautor-latky "We sent test samples to China. The drug may arrive in May, says co-author of anti-coronavirus substance"], [[ČT24]]. 18 February 2020.</ref> and four hundred patients in 50 other countries.<ref>Rodriguez, V., [https://www.denik.cz/zdravi/lek-na-koronavirus.html "Lék na koronavirus? Vláda ho objednala od českého odborníka"], ''[[Deník]]'', 16 March 2020.</ref> Remdesivir was used to treat the first confirmed case of coronavirus in the U.S.<ref>Walker, J., [https://www.wsj.com/articles/gilead-sciences-offers-experimental-drug-for-coronavirus-treatments-testing-11580511519 "Gilead Sciences Offers Experimental Drug for Coronavirus Treatments, Testing"], ''[[The Wall Street Journal]]'', 31 January 2020.</ref>{{efn|On 21 January 2020, the [[Wuhan Institute of Virology]] applied for a Chinese "use patent", for treatment of Covid-19.}} In early June 2020 it was reported that [[AstraZeneca]], a British-Swedish [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[pharmaceutical industry|pharmaceutical]] and [[biopharmaceutical]] company headquartered in [[Cambridge]], England, was pursuing a merger with Gilead due to a shared interest in the potential of remdesivir.<ref>Lavička, V., [https://archiv.ihned.cz/c1-66774810-astrazeneca-ma-zajem-o-tvurce-leku-remdesiviru-rysuje-se-nejvetsi-fuze-ve-vyrobe-leciv "AstraZeneca má zájem o tvůrce léku Remdesivir—Rýsuje se největší fúze ve výrobě léčiv"], ''[[Hospodářské noviny]]'', 9 June 2020.</ref>  However, in September 2020, the WHO’s guidelines committee issued a statement that there was no evidence of benefit.<ref name="who-lg">{{cite journal |vauthors=Lamontagne F, Agoritsas T, Macdonald H, Leo YS, Diaz J, Agarwal A, Appiah JA, Arabi Y, Blumberg L, Calfee CS, Cao B, Cecconi M, Cooke G, Dunning J, Geduld H, Gee P, Manai H, Hui DS, Kanda S, Kawano-Dourado L, Kim YJ, Kissoon N, Kwizera A, Laake JH, Machado FR, Qadir N, Sarin R, Shen Y, Zeng L, Brignardello-Petersen R, Lytvyn L, Siemieniuk R, Zeraatkar D, Bartoszko J, Ge L, Maguire B, Rochwerg B, Guyatt G, Vandvik PO |title=A living WHO guideline on drugs for covid-19 |journal=BMJ |volume=370 |article-number=m3379 |date=September 2020 |pmid=32887691 |doi=10.1136/bmj.m3379 |display-authors=5|doi-access=free |hdl=2429/78756 |hdl-access=free }}</ref> In October 2020, recognizing his involvement in the development of remdesivir, Czech president [[Miloš Zeman]] awarded Cihlář the country's [[:cs:Československá medaile za zásluhy|Silver Medal of Merit]].<ref>Ly, N. T., [https://www.e15.cz/domaci/zeman-ocenil-bojovniky-proti-koronaviru-i-veterany-vyznamenani-si-odnese-take-rychetsky-1374599 "Zeman ocenil bojovníky proti koronaviru i veterány. Vyznamenání si odnese také Rychetský"], [[E15 (newspaper)|E15]], 28 October 2020.</ref>

In April 2021 Cihlář discussed the possibility of marketing remdesivir in pill form.<ref>Zahradnická, E., [https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/remdesivir-tomas-cihlar-gilead-sciences-lek-koronavirus.A210420_201818_domaci_mama "Remdesivir chceme dostat do tabletek. Funguje i na mutace, říká český vývojář"], [[Mladá fronta DNES|iDNES.cz]], 21 April 2021.</ref>
